intro: IMS Noida is in Noida and Noida International University is in Greater Noida. This page compares their recorded Bachelor of Fine Arts (B.F.A) fees, placements, admission routes and campuses for 2026.

IMS Noida vs Noida International University is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: IMS Noida vs Noida International University for Bachelor of Fine Arts (B.F.A): which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IMS Noida if its Bachelor of Fine Arts (B.F.A) programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose Noida International University if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.
IMS Noida lists Bachelor of Fine Arts. Noida International University lists Bachelor of Fine Arts Applied Art, Bachelor of Fine Arts Painting.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records list ₹93,333 a year as tuition fees for IMS Noida's Bachelor of Fine Arts. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹60,000 a year as total fees for Noida International University's Bachelor of Fine Arts Applied Art. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for IMS Noida on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
